posts.name: Bigbywolfe
posts.cooked: This reorganization us terrible for me. Instead of checking one “Active topic” category that had every thing I was interested in (Sentinel Comics) I now have to check seven active topic categories. I know I speak only for myself, but this pretty much guarantees I’m going to miss things I’m interested in and generally reduce my participation in the forum because of it. Turning one easy place for everything you want (all things related to topic X, in my case SotM) to seven topics that aren’t even listed together but spread throughout a long list of other topics is so counterintuitive I’m having trouble understanding the reasoning behind it.
